entries.en: Added `StopFailure` hook event that fires when the turn ends due to an API error (rate limit, auth failure, etc.)
entries.zh: 添加了`StopFailure`挂钩事件，该事件在回合由于 API 错误（速率限制、身份验证失败等）而结束时触发

entries.en: Added `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}` variable for plugin persistent state that survives plugin updates; `/plugin uninstall` prompts before deleting it
entries.zh: 添加了`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}`变量，用于在插件更新后仍然存在的插件持久状态；删除前提示`/plugin uninstall`

entries.en: Added `effort`, `maxTurns`, and `disallowedTools` frontmatter support for plugin-shipped agents
entries.zh: 为插件提供的代理添加了 `effort`、`maxTurns` 和 `disallowedTools` frontmatter 支持

entries.en: Added `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION` env var to add a custom entry to the `/model` picker, with optional `_NAME` and `_DESCRIPTION` suffixed vars for display
entries.zh: 添加了`ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION`环境变量以将自定义条目添加到`/model`选择器，并带有可选的`_NAME`和`_DESCRIPTION`后缀变量用于显示

entries.en: Response text now streams line-by-line as it's generated
entries.zh: 回复文本现在会在生成时逐行流式显示

entries.en: Improved memory usage and startup time when resuming large sessions
entries.zh: 改进恢复大型会话时的内存占用和启动时间

entries.en: Terminal notifications (iTerm2/Kitty/Ghostty popups, progress bar) now reach the outer terminal when running inside tmux with `set -g allow-passthrough on`
entries.zh: 在 tmux 中运行时，只要设置 `set -g allow-passthrough on`，终端通知（iTerm2/Kitty/Ghostty 弹窗、进度条）就能送达外层终端

entries.en: Fixed `git log HEAD` failing with "ambiguous argument" inside sandboxed Bash on Linux, and stub files polluting `git status` in the working directory
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上沙盒 Bash 中`git log HEAD`因“模糊参数”而失败，以及存根文件污染工作目录中的`git status`的问题

entries.en: Fixed `cc log` and `--resume` silently truncating conversation history on large sessions (>5 MB) that used subagents
entries.zh: 修复了使用子代理的大型会话 (>5 MB) 上的`cc log`和`--resume`静默截断对话历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed infinite loop when API errors triggered stop hooks that re-fed blocking errors to the model
entries.zh: 修复了当 API 错误触发停止钩子时的无限循环，该停止钩子将阻塞错误重新馈送到模型

entries.en: Fixed `deny: ["mcp__servername"]` permission rules not removing MCP server tools before sending to the model, allowing it to see and attempt blocked tools
entries.zh: 修复了 `deny: ["mcp__servername"]` 权限规则，在发送到模型之前不会删除 MCP 服务器工具，从而允许其查看并尝试阻止的工具

entries.en: Fixed `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` not working with absolute paths (previously required `//` prefix)
entries.zh: 修复了`sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite`不适用于绝对路径（之前需要`//`前缀）

entries.en: Fixed `/sandbox` Dependencies tab showing Linux prerequisites on macOS instead of macOS-specific info
entries.zh: 修复了`/sandbox`“依赖项”选项卡，显示 macOS 上的 Linux 先决条件，而不是 macOS 特定的信息

entries.en: **Security:** Fixed silent sandbox disable when `sandbox.enabled: true` is set but dependencies are missing — now shows a visible startup warning
entries.zh: **安全性：** 修复了设置`sandbox.enabled: true`但缺少依赖项时静默沙箱禁用的问题 - 现在显示可见的启动警告

entries.en: Fixed `.git`, `.claude`, and other protected directories being writable without a prompt in `bypassPermissions` mode
entries.zh: 修复了`.git`、`.claude`和其他受保护目录在`bypassPermissions`模式下可写且无提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed ctrl+u in normal mode scrolling instead of readline kill-line (ctrl+u/ctrl+d half-page scroll moved to transcript mode only)
entries.zh: 修复了正常模式滚动中的 ctrl+u 而不是 readlinekill-line（ctrl+u/ctrl+d 半页滚动仅移至转录模式）

entries.en: Fixed voice mode modifier-combo push-to-talk keybindings (e.g. ctrl+k) requiring a hold instead of activating immediately
entries.zh: 修复一键通话的组合修饰键绑定（如 ctrl+k）需要长按才能激活、无法立即生效的问题

entries.en: Fixed voice mode not working on WSL2 with WSLg (Windows 11); WSL1/Win10 users now get a clear error
entries.zh: 修复 Windows 11 上 WSL2 与 WSLg 中语音模式无法工作的问题；WSL1 和 Win10 用户现在会收到明确错误

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` flag not loading skills and hooks from the worktree directory
entries.zh: 修复了`--worktree`标志未从工作树目录加载技能和挂钩的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` and `includeGitInstructions` setting not suppressing the git status section in the system prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` 和 `includeGitInstructions` 设置不抑制系统提示中的 git status 部分

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool not finding Homebrew and other PATH-dependent binaries when VS Code is launched from Dock/Spotlight
entries.zh: 修复了从 Dock/Spotlight 启动 VS Code 时 Bash 工具找不到 Homebrew 和其他依赖于 PATH 的二进制文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed washed-out Claude orange color in VS Code/Cursor/code-server terminals that don't advertise truecolor support
entries.zh: 修复在不声明支持 truecolor 的 VS Code/Cursor/code-server 终端中，Claude 橙色显示褪色的问题

entries.en: Fixed `ANTHROPIC_BETAS` environment variable being silently ignored when using Haiku models
entries.zh: 修复了使用俳句模型时`ANTHROPIC_BETAS`环境变量被默默忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed queued prompts being concatenated without a newline separator
entries.zh: 修复了在没有换行符的情况下连接排队提示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a brief flash of the login screen when opening the sidebar while already authenticated
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复已登录状态下打开侧边栏时，登录界面短暂闪现的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "API Error: Rate limit reached" when selecting Opus — model dropdown no longer offers 1M context variant to subscribers whose plan tier is unknown
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复选择 Opus 时出现 "API Error: Rate limit reached" 的问题：当套餐等级未知时，模型下拉菜单不再向订阅用户提供 1M 上下文版本
